options.horsingaround.title: Horsing Around
options.horsingaround.hard_cuts.tooltip: The further you turn the view from where the horse is going, the more it sits back, slows and cuts round tighter, like a real horse. Off: it turns at its usual rate whatever you ask.
options.horsingaround.horse_avoids.toolt: From a trot the horse steers round trees and rocks in as straight a line as it can, slows for walls, and won't run off a drop that would hurt it or into lava, fire or cactus.
options.horsingaround.climb_ledges.toolt: Ride straight at a ledge up to 2 blocks high and the horse jumps up onto it in its stride (from a canter or gallop it slows to a trot first). Never over fences or walls.
options.horsingaround.leaves.tooltip: Ridden horses push through leaves instead of being stopped by them. On a server, only if the server's own setting allows it too.
options.horsingaround.trample.tooltip: A horse going faster than a walk hurts and knocks aside small animals it runs through (never players or your pets). On a server, the server's settings decide.
message.horsingaround.server_missing: This server doesn't have Horsing Around, so horses ride as in vanilla
message.horsingaround.server_mismatch: This server runs Horsing Around %s, which doesn't match yours (%s), so horses ride as in vanilla
